events.what: Thin-set version of Manin's conjecture proved for the chordal cubic fourfold
Heath-Brown and Loughran prove Manin's conjecture for infinitely many quintic del Pezzo surfaces with a conic bundle structure
Version of Manin's conjecture over F_q (q large) for rational curves on split quartic del Pezzo surfaces via homological stability
Version of Manin's conjecture with Peyre's constant for quartic del Pezzo fibrations over global function fields

judgement.doubts: The function-field results are arguably variants (Manin's conjecture is usually posed over number fields); the F_q rational-curve count is treated here as a variant, but status does not depend on this since the number-field cases (chordal cubic fourfold, quintic del Pezzo family) are genuine cases. credited_humans lists authors of the other papers, not of arXiv:2504.16051, whose authors the record does not name; left unchanged rather than invent names. 'Sho Tanimoto' appears only in credited_humans, not in the summary or outcome.
